policies.name: Barter
policies.description: Local exchange with little administrative burden.

policies.name: Commodity Currency
policies.description: Standardized commodity money improves exchange but costs reserves.

policies.name: State Currency
policies.description: State-issued money improves coordination and increases institutional load.

policies.name: Communal Property
policies.description: Shared tenure protects farmers but limits owner control.

policies.name: Private Property
policies.description: Private tenure supports investment while increasing distributional conflict.

policies.name: State Enterprise
policies.description: Public ownership expands coordination at a high administrative cost.

policies.name: Restricted Trade
policies.description: Restricted exchange limits exposure and owner opportunities.

policies.name: Protectionist Trade
policies.description: Selective barriers protect producers and require customs administration.

policies.name: Open Trade
policies.description: Open exchange favors owners but increases future foreign exposure.

policies.name: Tribute
policies.description: Simple levies are cheap to administer but broadly unpopular.

policies.name: Land Tax
policies.description: Land assessment broadens revenue and burdens owners and farmers.

policies.name: Income Tax
policies.description: Income assessment supports services at high administrative complexity.

policies.name: Unregulated Labor
policies.description: Few restrictions maximize flexibility while exposing vulnerable cohorts.

policies.name: Basic Labor Protections
policies.description: Safety and cohort protections improve welfare at an enforcement cost.

policies.name: Organized Bargaining
policies.description: Formal bargaining strengthens workers and raises political organization.

policies.name: No Welfare
policies.description: No public relief preserves treasury but leaves shortages unbuffered.

policies.name: Targeted Relief
policies.description: Means-tested relief cushions hardship with moderate administrative load.

policies.name: Broad Provision
policies.description: Universal provision builds support but creates a large fiscal commitment.

policies.name: Unrestricted Extraction
policies.description: Unrestricted production has low overhead and high environmental cost.

policies.name: Extraction Quotas
policies.description: Quotas reduce damage while constraining extractive interests.

policies.name: Conservation Investment
policies.description: Restoration spending lowers persistent damage at substantial cost.
